business_problem: Established in 1972, Hokkaido Cultural Broadcasting serves its programs to the entire Hokkaido area as an affiliate of the Fuji Television Network .
solution_summary: Hokkaido Cultural Broadcasting airs a variety of news and shows that showcase the nature, food, and tourist attractions of Hokkaido, Japan. Expanding its online streaming services, the station used generative artificial intelligence (AI) and text-to-speech from Amazon Web Services (AWS) to streamline production of news scripts and videos, resulting in a low-cost solution to deliver more news. The broadcaster also made news sources easier to search using Amazon DynamoDB —a serverless, NoSQL database service. Sugimoto turned to AWS to streamline the production of news articles. Hokkaido Cultural Broadcasting had converted press releases to PDF format on a multifunction printer and emailed the PDF files to the news team.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Runs the foundation model layer for the document ingestion and extraction workflows.

solution_components.name: Claude 2
solution_components.role: Provides a large language model used by the document ingestion and extraction workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon DynamoDB
solution_components.role: Stores high-scale application state and metadata for the document ingestion and extraction workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon QuickSight
solution_components.role: Presents dashboards and analytics for the document ingestion and extraction workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Polly
solution_components.role: Generates speech output used by the document ingestion and extraction workflows.
